CreateQuotaAlarm.description_en: Creates an alert rule for a quota item

CreateQuotaApplicationsForTemplate.description_en: Creates batch quota increase applications for members in a resource folder. When you add a quota item to a quota template, only new members in the resource folder autocommit quota increase applications, and existing members remain unchanged. To increase quotas for existing members by using a quota template, you can select the quota template to commit batch quota increase applications for multiple members in the resource folder. Only the administrator account of the resource folder can create batch quota applications
CreateQuotaApplicationsForTemplate.description_zh: 当您将配额项加入配额模板时，仅资源目录中新增的成员会自动提交配额提升申请，已有成员无变化。如果您需要通过配额模板为已有成员提升配额，则可以批量选择配额模板为资源目录中的多个成员提交配额提升申请。只有资源目录的管理员账号可批量创建配额申请

CreateTemplateQuotaItem.description_en: Creates a quota template. After the management account creates a quota template, the template automatically submits quota increase applications for new members added to the resource directory. Existing members remain unaffected. You can use a quota template to apply for increases to multiple quota items at a time, improving the efficiency and automation of quota management across the organization. Only the management account of a resource directory can create a quota template
CreateTemplateQuotaItem.description_zh: 管理账号创建配额模板后，如果资源目录新增成员，则配额模板自动为新增的成员提交配额提升申请，已有成员无变化。通过配额模板，您一次可以申请提升多个配额项，提升整个组织的配额管理效率和自动化水平。只有资源目录的管理员账号可创建配额模版

DeleteTemplateQuotaItem.description_en: Deletes a quota template. After the management account deletes a quota template, the template no longer automatically submits quota increase requests for new members added to the resource directory. Only the management account of the resource directory can delete quota templates
DeleteTemplateQuotaItem.description_zh: 管理账号删除配额模板后，如果资源目录新增成员，则配额模板不再自动为新增的成员提交配额提升申请。只有资源目录的管理员账号可删除配额模版

GetProductQuota.description_en: Queries the quota details of a specified cloud service
GetProductQuota.description_zh: 查询目标云产品的配额详情

GetProductQuotaDimension.description_en: Queries the details of the quota dimensions supported by the target cloud service
GetProductQuotaDimension.description_zh: 查询目标云产品支持的配额维度详情

GetQuotaAlarm.description_en: Queries the details of a specified quota alert
GetQuotaAlarm.description_zh: 查询目标配额告警详情

GetQuotaApplication.description_en: Queries the details of a quota increase application
GetQuotaApplication.description_zh: 查询配额提升申请详情

GetQuotaApplicationApproval.description_en: Queries the approval information of a quota application, including the average approval time, whether approval reminders are supported, and the approval reminder interval
GetQuotaApplicationApproval.description_zh: 查询配额申请单审批信息。其中包含：平均审批时间、是否支持审批提醒和审批提醒间隔时间等

GetQuotaTemplateServiceStatus.description_en: Queries the status of the quota template

GetQuotaUtilizationOverview.description_en: Retrieves an overview of quota usage

ListAlarmHistories.description_en: Queries the history of quota alerts
ListAlarmHistories.description_zh: 查询配额告警历史记录

ListDependentQuotas.description_en: Queries the list of quotas associated with a specific quota. Some quotas are interdependent and should be increased simultaneously
ListDependentQuotas.description_zh: 部分配额之间存在关联，关联配额最好同时提升，该接口返回某个配额关联的配额项列表

ListProductDimensionGroups.description_en: This operation queries the dimension groups of a specified Alibaba Cloud service
ListProductDimensionGroups.description_zh: 查询目标云产品的维度组

ListProductQuotaDimensions.description_en: Queries the quota dimensions supported by the specified cloud service
ListProductQuotaDimensions.description_zh: 查询目标云产品支持的配额维度

ListProductQuotas.description_en: Queries the quotas of a specified cloud service
ListProductQuotas.description_zh: 查询目标云产品的配额列表

ListProducts.description_en: Queries the list of Alibaba Cloud services supported by Quota Center
ListProducts.description_zh: 查询配额中心支持的云产品列表

ListQuotaAlarms.description_zh: 查询配额用量告警列表

ListQuotaApplicationTemplates.description_en: Queries quota templates by using the management account of a resource directory
ListQuotaApplicationTemplates.description_zh: Queries quota templates by using the management account of a resource directory

ListQuotaApplications.description_en: Queries the list of quota increase applications
ListQuotaApplications.description_zh: 查询配额提升申请列表

ListQuotaApplicationsDetailForTemplate.description_en: Queries the details of quota increase applications for a member in a resource directory
ListQuotaApplicationsDetailForTemplate.description_zh: 查询资源目录中成员配额提升申请详情

ListQuotaApplicationsForTemplate.description_en: Queries the history of batch requests for member quotas submitted using a quota template
ListQuotaApplicationsForTemplate.description_zh: 查询配额模板批量申请成员配额的申请历史

ModifyQuotaTemplateServiceStatus.description_en: Changes the status of a quota template. By default, the quota template is not configured. If the management account of a resource directory uses a quota template for the first time, you must enable the quota template. Only the management account of a resource directory can change the status of quota templates
ModifyQuotaTemplateServiceStatus.description_zh: 配额模板的默认状态为未设置。当资源目录的管理账号初次使用配额模板时，需要开启配额模板。只有资源目录的管理员账号可修改配额模版

ModifyTemplateQuotaItem.description_en: Only the administrator account of a resource directory can modify a quota template. Modifications to a quota template apply only to new members that are added to the resource directory and do not affect existing members
ModifyTemplateQuotaItem.description_zh: 管理账号修改配额模板后，修改结果仅对资源目录中管理账号新增的成员生效，已有成员无变化。只有资源目录的管理员账号可修改配额模版

RemindQuotaApplicationApproval.description_en: Sends a reminder for a quota application that is pending approval
RemindQuotaApplicationApproval.description_zh: 查询支持审批提醒的配额申请单

StartQuotaUtilizationReport.description_en: Initiates a quota usage report query. This API applies only to general quotas
StartQuotaUtilizationReport.description_zh: 发起配额使用率报告查询，本api只对通用配额生效
